messages:
Maya: Quick sync — drafting the webinar roadmap + seed journey scripts. Goal: tie free credits + prompt templates to first-run activation within 3 steps. Can we lock messaging + benchmark metrics by EOD? Short outline below.

Maya: Outline: 1) Webinar narrative (why Redwood, cost/latency tradeoffs) 2) Prompt starter pack + demo 3) Free credits gating + onboarding drip 4) Routing for inbound sales leads + CS handoff

Liam: Love it. Suggest A/B test two hooks: 'Launch to first run in 5 min' vs 'Cut token spend with prompt templates' — different CTAs and email subject lines.

Ara: Copy idea for webinar CTA subject: "Ship an LLM feature — free credits & starter prompts". Short, benefit-led.

Sam: Prefer even shorter: "Build with Redwood: free credits + prompts" — can we test both?

Nina: For benchmarks I'll need: activation rate (first API call within 24h), 7-day retention, avg token spend first 7 days, and conversion to dedicated trial. I'll wire a dashboard. Need cohort defs from marketing.

Maya: Cohorts: new signups in last 72h. Activated = first generation within 24h of signup. Convert-to-paid window = 30 days.

growth-bot: Experiment created: /growth experiments create seed-journey-webinar --id EXP-4821 --variants=hookA,hookB --start=2026-04-02

Liam: Routing question — can webinar registrants be auto-flagged for the credit drip? Also CS wants high-ARPU companies routed to sales.

Maya: Routing plan: if company_size > 50 or MRR signal present => route to #sales-inbound as high-touch; else trigger 3-email credit drip + promptpack in product onboarding.

Sam: Prompt templates: curate 3 starter templates (chat assistant short, summarize long docs, code completion). Keep token length low for the demo. Add suggested system messages.

Ara: Also need the demo script to call out batching & latency numbers — show Hosted vs Dedicated for 256-token sequence. Small table in slides.

Nina: Add an eval set: 10 canonical prompts per template so we can monitor quality/regression post-rollout. I'll run baseline scores before the event.

Liam: For A/B variants I'll need UTM + email snippets. Planning notes: 2 subject lines, 1 preheader, 1 CTA. Can someone own the email copy?

Maya: UTM: campaign=seed-webinar2026, source=webinar, variant={{variant}}. Email preheader: "Free credits + starter prompts to ship your first LLM feature"

Sam: I'll own landing + email copy. Will draft by tomorrow noon and share in #marketing-review.

Liam: I'll set up the A/B test in Launchpad once copy and UTMs are final. Also adding a small experiment: variant B includes a flow where registrants get an in-product modal with one-click redeem credits.

Maya: Nice. Make sure the modal flow triggers the onboarding path (promptpack + sample requests).

Nina: Power calc: to detect a ~5% absolute lift in activation we need ~400 registrants per arm. Expect ~8–12% conversion from invite => registrant.

Ara: Quick copy tweak suggestion for landing H1: "From zero to first LLM call — with free credits and playbook"

Sam: Adding creative note: 3 short testimonial blurbs from existing PLG customers, emphasis on latency + predictable cost.

Maya: Action items: Sam (landing + copy) by tomorrow noon; Liam (Launchpad setup + UTMs) by EOD tomorrow; Nina (dashboard + eval sets) by EOD today; Ara (slide copy + demo script) by EOD tomorrow.

Liam: I'll also ping eng for the Dedicated latency numbers to include as benchmarks.

growth-bot: Reminder: add experiment checklist items -> tracking events: signup, reg_confirm, first_generation, redeem_credits, converted_trial

Nina: I'll validate instrumentation after Launchpad is live.

Maya: :thumbsup: Thanks team — reconvene tomorrow 10am PT to review drafts.

Liam: :white_check_mark:

Sam: Got it, will post draft link in this thread.

Ara: I'll iterate slide copy tonight and drop notes.

Nina: Reporting template I'll post to the dashboard, tagging results by variant.

Maya: Closing for now — appreciate the quick turnaround.
